cohort: 169 maternal-neonatal pairs at 2 tertiary care centers
finding: Cord blood cortisol levels did not mediate the association between maternal pre-BMI and birth weight, but a positive correlation was found between cord blood cortisol levels and HDL-C levels, while maternal pre-BMI and birth weight were negatively correlated with HDL-C levels.
birth_weight: increased by 90.5 g for each unit increase in maternal pre-BMI
